abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Brostamide improves systolic drop compared with Standard care.
conclusion: To sum up, the comparison of the groups shows the following. Overall, Brostamide improves systolic drop compared with Standard care.
section:
### Additional comparison

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. All data for this comparison were collected at the Oakfield Family Cohort.
